<div class="topbar"><div class="container"><span>🇰🇭 Cambodia Business Registration & Tax Support</span><span>Professional • Responsive • Confidential</span></div></div>
<header class="header"><div class="container nav"><a class="brand" href="#home"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,





" alt="NH Registration & Tax logo"><span><strong>NH Registration & Tax</strong><small>R
EGISTRATION • TAX CONSULTING • BUSINESS SOLUTIONS</small></span></a><nav class="links"><a href="#home" data-i18n="home">Home</a><a href="#services" data-i18n="services">Services</a><a href="#process" data-i18n="process">Process</a><a href="#portal" data-i18n="portal">Client Portal</a><a href="#contact" data-i18n="contact">Contact</a></nav><div class="actions"><button class="lang" id="langBtn" onclick="setLang()">ខ្មែរ</button><button class="btn dark" onclick="openLogin()">🔐 <span data-i18n="login">Client Login</span></button></div></div></header>
<main id="home">
<section class="hero"><div class="container"><div><span class="eyebrow">✦ YOUR BUSINESS, OUR EXPERTISE</span><h1 data-i18n="hero">Registration, Tax & Business Solutions</h1><p data-i18n="heroP">Professional support for business registration, tax registration, document preparation and related administrative services in Cambodia.</p><div class="hero-buttons"><button class="btn gold" onclick="scrollToId('portal')">➜ <span data-i18n="request">Request a Service</span></button><a class="btn light" href="#services">▣ <span data-i18n="view">View Services</span></a></div></div><div class="hero-card"><img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,






" alt="NH Registration & Tax"><div class="mini"><div><b>2 weeks</b><span>Express processing</span></div><div><b>4 weeks</b><span>Standard processing</span></div></div></div></div></section>
<section id="services" class="section alt"><div class="container">
<div class="section-head"><div><span class="eyebrow" style="background:#edf3f9;color:var(--navy);border-color:#dce6f2" data-i18n="servicesEyebrow">NH BUSINESS SERVICES</span><h2 data-i18n="servicesTitle">Complete Business Registration, Tax & Licensing Services</h2></div><p data-i18n="servicesIntro">NH Registration & Tax supports companies, entrepreneurs and investors with registration, tax, licensing, legal-document and compliance-related services in Cambodia.</p></div>
<div class="service-toolbar"><input id="serviceSearch" oninput="filterServices()" placeholder="Search services / ស្វែងរកសេវាកម្ម..."><select id="serviceCategory" onchange="filterServices()"><option value="all">All services</option><option value="registration">Registration</option><option value="tax">Tax</option><option value="license">Licensing</option><option value="legal">Legal & Documents</option><option value="export">Import / Export</option><option value="factory">Factory & QIP</option></select></div>
<div class="grid3" id="serviceGrid">
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="registration" data-key="company registration ចុះបញ្ជីក្រុមហ៊ុន អ្នកជាប់ពន្ធតូច មធ្យម ធំ"><div class="icon">🏢</div><h3>Company Registration</h3><p>New company registration for small, medium and large taxpayer categories, including registration support with relevant authorities.</p><div class="service-km">ចុះបញ្ជីក្រុមហ៊ុនថ្មី អ្នកជាប់ពន្ធតូច ពន្ធមធ្យម និងពន្ធធំ។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Company Registration')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="legal" data-key="lawyer legal contract defense ការពារក្តី ព្រៀងកិច្ចសន្យា"><div class="icon">⚖️</div><h3>Legal Services</h3><p>Legal-document support, contract preparation, coordination of legal matters and representation support for factories or enterprises.</p><div class="service-km">សេវាមេធាវី ការពារក្តី ព្រៀងកិច្ចសន្យា សម្របសម្រួលការងារផ្លូវច្បាប់ និងឈរតំណាង។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Legal Services')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="tax" data-key="monthly annual tax ប្រកាសពន្ធ ប្រចាំខែ ប្រចាំឆ្នាំ"><div class="icon">🧾</div><h3>Monthly & Annual Tax</h3><p>Preparation and support for monthly and annual tax declarations and related tax compliance work.</p><div class="service-km">ប្រកាសពន្ធប្រចាំខែ និងប្រចាំឆ្នាំ។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Monthly & Annual Tax')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="tax" data-key="GDT tax update ពន្ធដារ បច្ចុប្បន្នភាព"><div class="icon">🔄</div><h3>Tax Department Updates</h3><p>Support for changes and updates at the General Department of Taxation, including related registrations and records.</p><div class="service-km">សេវាបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព និងកែប្រែផ្សេងៗនៅអគ្គនាយកដ្ឋានពន្ធដារ។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Tax Department Updates')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="factory" data-key="QIP factory garment shoe bag components រោងចក្រ QIP"><div class="icon">🏭</div><h3>Factory & QIP Applications</h3><p>Support for QIP and factory establishment applications for garment, footwear, bags, components and other manufacturing activities.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំបង្កើតរោងចក្រ QIP គ្រប់ប្រភេទ។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Factory & QIP')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="foreign work permit card ជនបរទេស កាតការងារ"><div class="icon">🌐</div><h3>Foreign Worker Services</h3><p>Support for applications related to work cards and permits for foreign employees.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំកាតការងារ និងឯកសារពាក់ព័ន្ធសម្រាប់ជនបរទេស។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Foreign Worker Services')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="handicraft license ច្បាប់សិប្បកម្ម ចបផ"><div class="icon">🛠️</div><h3>Handicraft License</h3><p>Application and document support for handicraft licenses and related permits.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំច្បាប់សិប្បកម្ម និងលិខិតអនុញ្ញាតសិប្បកម្ម។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Handicraft License')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="halal HALAL certificate"><div class="icon">☪️</div><h3>HALAL Certification</h3><p>Application support and document preparation for HALAL certification.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំវិញ្ញាបនបត្រ HALAL។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('HALAL Certification')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="construction license level 1 2 3 អាជ្ញាប័ណ្ណសាងសង់"><div class="icon">🏗️</div><h3>Construction Licenses</h3><p>Support for construction license applications at Level 01, Level 02 and Level 03, subject to applicable requirements.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំអាជ្ញាប័ណ្ណសាងសង់ កម្រិត ០១, ០២ និង ០៣។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Construction License')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="road license ផ្លូវថ្នល់"><div class="icon">🛣️</div><h3>Road License Services</h3><p>Support for road-related license applications and document processing.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំអាជ្ញាប័ណ្ណផ្លូវថ្នល់។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Road License')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="license" data-key="private security license សន្តិសុខឯកជន"><div class="icon">🛡️</div><h3>Private Security License</h3><p>Application and document support for private security service licensing.</p><div class="service-km">អាជ្ញាប័ណ្ណសេវាសន្តិសុខឯកជន។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Private Security License')">Request quotation</button></div>
<div class="card service-card" data-cat="export" data-key="certificate of origin CO export ការនាំចេញ"><div class="icon">📦</div><h3>Certificate of Origin (CO)</h3><p>Support for Certificate of Origin applications for exported goods.</p><div class="service-km">ស្នើសុំ CO សម្រាប់នាំចេញទំនិញ។</div><button class="btn light service-btn" onclick="requestService('Certificate of Origin')">Request quotation</button></div>

let lang='en';

function translateStatic(toKhmer){
  document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,p,a,button,span,label,option,li').forEach(el=>{
    if(el.closest('script,style') || el.children.length) return;
    if(!el.dataset.enText) el.dataset.enText=el.textContent;
    const en=el.dataset.enText.trim();
    if(!en) return;
    if(toKhmer && translationsKM[en]) el.textContent=translationsKM[en];
    else if(!toKhmer) el.textContent=el.dataset.enText;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea').forEach(el=>{
    if(!el.dataset.enPlaceholder) el.dataset.enPlaceholder=el.placeholder||'';
    if(toKhmer){
      if(el.dataset.enPlaceholder==='Email or phone') el.placeholder='អ៊ីមែល ឬទូរស័ព្ទ';
      else if(el.dataset.enPlaceholder==='Brief description') el.placeholder='ពិពណ៌នាសង្ខេប';
      else if(el.dataset.enPlaceholder==='Enter application ID') el.placeholder='បញ្ចូលលេខសម្គាល់សំណើ';
    } else el.placeholder=el.dataset.enPlaceholder;
  });
}

function setHeroLanguage(toKhmer){
  const h=document.querySelector('h1[data-i18n="hero"]');
  if(!h) return;
  h.innerHTML=toKhmer
    ? '<span>ការចុះបញ្ជី ពន្ធ</span> និងដំណោះស្រាយអាជីវកម្ម'
    : '<span>Registration, Tax</span> &amp; Business Solutions';
}
function setLang(){
  lang=lang==='en'?'km':'en';
  translateStatic(lang==='km');
  setHeroLanguage(lang==='km');
  document.getElementById('langBtn').textContent=lang==='en'?'ខ្មែរ':'EN';
  document.documentElement.lang=lang;
  localStorage.setItem('nh_lang',lang);
}

function openLogin(){document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.add('open')}
function closeLogin(){document.getElementById('loginModal').classList.remove('open')}
function login(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('loginStatus').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('loginStatus').textContent=lang==='km'?'ការចូលប្រព័ន្ធសាកល្បងបានជោគជ័យ។ សូមស្វាគមន៍មកកាន់ផ្ទាំងសេវាអតិថិជន។':'Demo login successful. Welcome to the client portal.';
  setTimeout(closeLogin,900)
}
function requestService(name){
  document.getElementById('reqService').value=[...document.getElementById('reqService').options].some(o=>o.text===name)?name:'Other Service';
  document.getElementById('portal').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('reqName').focus(),500)
}
function submitRequest(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const id='NH-'+Math.floor(100000+Math.random()*900000);
  document.getElementById('requestId').textContent=id;
  document.getElementById('requestStatus').style.display='block';
  localStorage.setItem('nh_last_request',id);
}
function adminLogin(){document.getElementById('adminPanel').classList.toggle('hide')}
function checkStatus(){
  const id=document.getElementById('statusId').value.trim();
  const box=document.getElementById('checkStatus');
  box.style.display='block';
  box.textContent=id
    ? (lang==='km'?'សំណើ '+id+' កំពុងស្ថិតក្នុងដំណាក់កាលពិនិត្យឯកសារ (ស្ថានភាពសាកល្បង)។':'Application '+id+' is currently under document review (demo status).')
    : (lang==='km'?'សូមបញ្ចូលលេខសម្គាល់សំណើរបស់អ្នក។':'Please enter your application ID.');
}
function scrollToId(id){document.getElementById(id).scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
function filterServices(){
  const q=document.getElementById('serviceSearch').value.toLowerCase();
  const cat=document.getElementById('serviceCategory').value;
  document.querySelectorAll('.service-card').forEach(c=>{
    const okq=!q||c.dataset.key.includes(q);
    const okc=cat==='all'||c.dataset.cat===cat;
    c.style.display=okq&&okc?'':'none'
  })
}
function filterAdmin(){
  const q=document.getElementById('adminSearch').value.toLowerCase();
  const st=document.getElementById('adminStatus').value;
  document.querySelectorAll('#adminRows tr').forEach(r=>{
    const txt=r.textContent.toLowerCase();
    const status=r.cells[3]?.textContent.trim()||'';
    r.style.display=(!q||txt.includes(q))&&(st==='all'||status===st)?'':'none'
  })
}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='loginModal')closeLogin()});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  const saved=localStorage.getItem('nh_lang');
  if(saved==='km'){lang='km';translateStatic(true);setHeroLanguage(true);document.getElementById('langBtn').textContent='EN';document.documentElement.lang='km';}
});
</script></body></html>
